name: vault-distiller
description: Distill, tag, summarize, and cross-link notes using a local offline Ollama instance.

scripts.bump: node version-bump.mjs patch && npm run build
scripts.bump:minor: node version-bump.mjs minor && npm run build
scripts.bump:major: node version-bump.mjs major && npm run build
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
